g.text: Auth0 login to Google Cloud Storage with Workload Identity Federation
2. Exchange the token for a Google access token
1. signature and iss match the provider's issuer_uri
2. aud contains an allowed_audiences entry (our API)
(rejects ID tokens and tokens for other APIs)
3. attribute_condition: azp is the SPA or CLI client ID
3. Use Cloud Storage with the federated token
The pool principal itself holds roles/storage.objectUser on the bucket
Unlike the AWS demo this grant is pool-wide: no per-user prefix isolation.
